hard_cap_triggered.rule: Spec misunderstands the core business intent
Spec produces zero clarifying questions despite obvious ambiguities
Spec contains no edge cases or exception handling at all
Spec is unstructured text with no requirement numbering, user stories, or acceptance criteria

dimension_1.justification: The specification captures all explicit requirements (drafting, brief deliverables, budget, eligibility, and marketplace discovery) while proactively deriving implicit requirements such as campaign lifecycle controls (pause/resume/close/cancel in US-006) and Celery-based automated deadline expiration (US-007). In fact, it improves upon the reference spec by explicitly defining the creator marketplace search and view flows (US-004, US-005) rather than focusing solely on brand administration.

dimension_2.justification: The agent identifies 8 comprehensive, highly relevant edge cases (EC-001 through EC-008) spanning optimistic concurrency control (OCC via version headers), network retries and idempotency keys, post-publication budget immutability, enumeration defense (HTTP 404 on unapproved briefs), upstream dependency failure, and input sanitization. Each edge case is accompanied by a concrete, production-ready technical handling strategy.

dimension_3.justification: The spec raises 5 genuine, non-obvious architectural ambiguities (Q-001 through Q-005) covering payment escrow scope, service boundary separation for creator applications, soft vs. hard eligibility gating, multi-user organization tenancy, and media attachment hosting. Each question directly influences implementation design and includes a pragmatic, stated assumption tailored for the 4-week MVP timeline.

dimension_4.justification: The document exhibits exemplary structure with consistent, unique identification across all user stories (US-001 to US-007), state transitions (T-01 to T-08), edge cases, and clarifying questions. Requirements and acceptance criteria are atomic, testable, specify exact HTTP status codes, and are organized into clear sprint-based P0/P1/P2 priority classifications.

dimension_5.justification: Non-functional requirements are thorough, quantitative, and tailored to the specified FastAPI/Postgres/Redis/Celery stack, including P95 latency targets (<80ms cached feed), throughput expectations (500 RPS), and 64-bit integer cents for currency precision. Security (JWKS verification, rate limiting) and data integrity (DB CHECK constraints, Celery task_acks_late) are fully addressed with high feasibility awareness.

scores.overall_assessment: This is an exceptional, production-grade requirements specification that comprehensively addresses the business requirements, rigorously plans for real-world failure modes, and establishes precise architectural boundaries appropriate for a 4-week delivery.
